title: Offer detail (M2)
brief: Offer detail screen of goop, opened with enter on an offer row: header with score, verdict, NEW, source and date; why it fits (matched requirements, gaps, seniority); goop's summary; a pointer to the untrusted original text (M3); actions s save, d dismiss, o open, a ask goop, f full text, esc back; status line with the detail focus mode.

artboards.title: Full screen
artboards.tradeoff: Calmest read with requirements and summary side by side; hides the list and the chat, so moving between offers needs [ ] or esc

artboards.title: Split with the offers sidebar
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps the session layout and the list: ↑↓ moves through offers and the detail follows; half the width, so long offers scroll
